entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: These paintings are all over this Palace...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ever since we came in here, it felt like[n]we were being watched...
entries.uk: Відколи ми сюди зайшли, було відчуття,[n]ніби за нами стежать...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Knowing what we know now, it makes[n]sense why it felt like that.
entries.uk: Тепер, коли ми знаємо правду,[n]зрозуміло чому.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I heard this pupil has already retired[n]from art. They supposedly have no[n]desire to paint again...
entries.uk: Я чув, ця людина вже покинула[n]мистецтво. Кажуть, не має[n]бажання малювати знову...
